text:
nina: just opened a PR updating the model-card for Polaris13b about max sequence and benchmark links. Found ambiguous wording around 'effective seq limit' when using quantized variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4902 - quick eyes please.

aaron: quick read: please avoid saying 'no support' for quantized runtime. Suggest 'reduced effective context' and link to the runtime compatibility note.

sam: also add a code snippet for SDK v3 showing how to set `max_tokens` and handle TruncatedResponse exception. Many users copy-paste the example and hit silent truncation.

bake: (typo) I mean blake: From eng-ml: quantized kernels drop context past 2048 for this model in int8 on older runtimes. Newer runtimes with chunked attention preserve it. I'll add a one-liner compatibility note and reference the runtime changelog.

nina: added snippet and changed wording to 'reduced effective context on older int8 runtimes'. snippet: ```python
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(model='polaris13b', input=prompt, max_tokens=1800)
if resp.truncated:
    # recommend streaming or hosted fallback
    handle_truncation()
```

aaron: nit: use `truncate_warning` field name in snippet to match SDK response shape.

docs-bot: preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/4902 :white_check_mark:

sam: LGTM from docs. CI smoke test added that runs the snippet against a 2200-token fixture.

nina: thanks all, merging after CI. I'll file a follow-up to add a short troubleshooting note to Support playbook.

aaron: filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1190
